## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for changed code
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm gitleaks` passes locally
- [ ] User-facing strings updated in both `es.json` and `en.json`
- [ ] Docs updated if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] No new outbound network calls, new persisted data, or telemetry (or justified above)
- [ ] Commit(s) signed (`git commit -S`)
